subject: bia
title: BIA.------INFO.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 436 (TRF(CW)-8). BIA (bi-aitional) is the subject; INFO-DY is the partner. From the subject: AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree), C-CONT (composite continuance) and AFI-1 (affinity insight (1)). From AFI-2: ALT-FT (alternative functionalism). From C-CONT: WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) and C-INFO (composite information). From AFI-1: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From SPT-DY: RT-DY (reality dynamics). The text on the same page speaks of "creative music of the affinity insight (1) principle".
